newsitem.title: USA: Conseco sees Pioneer deal adding to EPS.
newsitem.headline: Conseco sees Pioneer deal adding to EPS.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Monday it expects its planned purchase of Pioneer Financial Services Inc will add about $0.15 per fullly diluted share to its operating earnings in the first year.
Earlier Monday, Conseco announced it agreed to acquire Pioneer for $25 to $28 a share of its stock in a deal valued at about $477 million.

Conseco Chairman Stephen Hilbert said his company's strategy is to become the premier provider in the United States of insurance products to consumers aged 40 and over. To do that, it is strengthening its major product lines of supplemental health insurance, retirement annuities and life insurance products.

"This transaction, which is expected to add approximately 15 cents to Conseco's operating earnings per fully diluted share in the first year, represents another important step toward that objective," Hilbert said.
